style: 3D-rendered chibi figurine in the style of a felted-wool / knitted-yarn collectible toy. Hair and clothing show visible soft fibre and knit texture; skin is smooth matte vinyl with soft blush; eyes are large glossy anime-style with layered highlights and a gradient iris. Proportions about 2.5 heads tall, big round head, tiny body, stubby limbs. Soft even studio lighting, no rim light, no bokeh. PURE WHITE background, no floor shadow, no environment, no text, no watermark.
turnaround: CHARACTER TURNAROUND SHEET. One wide image containing four full-body views of the SAME character placed side by side in a single row, left to right: (1) front view, (2) three-quarter view, (3) exact side profile view, (4) back view. Every view uses the identical neutral standing pose: arms relaxed slightly away from the body, hands open, feet together, weight centred. Neutral calm expression, mouth closed. NO props, NO held items. All four figures are the same height and share one eye-line; keep spacing even. Plain white background, no labels, no grid lines. This sheet must match the attached reference image exactly in face, hair, colours and outfit.
expressions: EXPRESSION SHEET. One image containing a clean 3x3 grid of nine head-and-shoulders portraits of the SAME character, all front-facing, identical head size and framing in every cell, thin light-grey grid lines separating cells. Row 1 left to right: neutral / happy with open-mouth smile / sad with teary eyes. Row 2: angry with puffed cheeks / surprised with wide eyes and small open mouth / shy-embarrassed with heavy blush looking away. Row 3: sleepy with half-closed eyes / smug-proud with a confident smirk / crying with big tears. Plain white background in every cell, no text labels. Face, hair, eye design and colours must match the attached reference image exactly.
prop: PROP REFERENCE SHEET. One wide image showing a SINGLE object only, no character, no hands, no body parts. Show the same object three times side by side in one row, left to right: (1) front view, (2) three-quarter view, (3) exact side view. All three are the same size, evenly spaced, sharing one baseline. Plain PURE WHITE background, no floor shadow, no labels, no text. The attached image is the character who owns this object: use it ONLY to match colours, materials and toy style. Do NOT draw the character.

FUFU-enfp.name: FUFU
FUFU-enfp.description: A cheerful chibi girl. Bright tangerine-orange fluffy medium-length bob hair with soft flipped ends and a single tall curled ahoge on top. An orange-slice hair clip with two green felt leaves on the right side of her head. Large round warm orange eyes with a honey gradient and big white highlights. Rosy blush. Outfit: an oversized cream fleece pullover hoodie with orange-and-cream striped cuffs, an orange-slice patch pocket on the front, two orange pom-pom drawstrings, hood lined in orange; a green canvas crossbody strap with a small round orange plush bag shaped like a smiling orange with leaves; white knit knee socks with tiny orange embroidery; orange-and-white low-top sneakers with white laces.
FUFU-enfp.props: orange-slice hair clip; smiling orange plush crossbody bag with green strap

haide-entp.name: haide
haide-entp.description: A mischievous chibi husky puppy (quadruped, walks on four legs). Thick fluffy fur, dark slate-grey on the back, ears, and head mask, cream-white on the muzzle, chest, belly and paws, pink inner ears. Big round bright blue eyes with white highlights, thick expressive arched eyebrows, black shiny nose, small fangs showing in a cheeky grin. A red leather collar with a silver buckle and a round silver ID tag. Bushy curled tail with a white tip. Chunky short legs.
haide-entp.props: red leather collar with round silver tag
haide-entp.turnaround_note: This character is a four-legged dog. Show all four views standing on four legs: front, three-quarter, side profile, and back. Mouth closed in a neutral calm expression.

lukos-infj.name: lukos
lukos-infj.description: A quiet, gentle chibi boy. Blue-grey messy yarn-textured hair with soft spikes and one loose curled ahoge. Large grey-blue eyes with a soft gradient, slightly worried upward-slanting eyebrows, soft blush. Outfit: an oversized blue-grey chunky knit cardigan with cream and dusty-pink stripes on the cuffs and hem, wooden buttons; a very thick blue-grey and cream striped knitted scarf wrapped around the neck with tassel fringe and a small brown leather patch; a cream shirt underneath; dark grey textured trousers rolled at the ankle; grey-and-white high-top sneakers with white laces.
lukos-infj.props: striped blue-grey and cream chunky scarf; small bouquet of pink tulips wrapped in kraft paper with a pink ribbon

Mimi-enfj.name: Mimi
Mimi-enfj.description: A bold, confident chibi girl. Deep violet-purple spiky hair with a high side ponytail on the right, tied with a purple band and a silver star hair clip. Sharp large violet-purple eyes with a confident narrowed look and a small smirk, thin angled eyebrows. Outfit: a purple-and-white varsity jacket with white fleece sleeves, purple body, silver zipper, and a white star patch on the chest, worn open over a black hoodie with purple drawstrings; a black pleated mini skirt with a purple hem stripe; mismatched socks, left black with a purple star, right white with a black star; purple-black-white high-top sneakers with star details.
Mimi-enfj.props: silver baseball bat with purple grip and purple stripes; silver star hair clip

prop_items.desc: A chibi-scale baseball bat: glossy silver metallic barrel, a deep violet-purple rubber wrapped grip with a small round knob at the end, and two thin purple stripes near the top of the barrel, plus a tiny white star mark on the barrel. Purple must match the character's jacket and hair.

whiskle-infp.name: whiskle
whiskle-infp.description: A soft-spoken, plant-loving chibi BOY with a delicate, very pretty androgynous face that is often mistaken for a girl's; still clearly a boy in build and outfit. Long sage-green yarn hair with a side-swept fringe and a single long braid over the right shoulder tied with a cream ribbon and a small brass leaf clip. Large moss-green eyes with a golden gradient, gentle shy expression, soft blush. Outfit: an olive-green chunky cable-knit cardigan with wooden buttons; a cream mandarin-collar shirt; brown textured cropped trousers gathered at the knee; cream ribbed knit socks; brown leather lace-up ankle boots; a brown leather crossbody satchel with pencils sticking out.
whiskle-infp.props: small terracotta pot with a green seedling; dark green hardcover journal with a gold leaf emblem; brown leather satchel with pencils

点儿-intp.name: 点儿
点儿-intp.description: A calm, nerdy chibi boy. Silver-grey short yarn hair with a straight fringe and one thin ahoge. Black thin rectangular glasses. Large cool grey eyes with a subtle blue gradient, relaxed half-smile. Outfit: a white-cream fleece zip-up hoodie with small grey checkerboard patches on the sleeves, worn open; a light grey t-shirt with a faint checker print; white cargo joggers with grey checker patches and side pockets; white-and-grey chunky sneakers; white over-ear headphones with grey checker ear cups worn around the neck.
点儿-intp.props: white game controller; white over-ear headphones; black rectangular glasses

艾莎-intj.name: 艾莎
艾莎-intj.description: A composed, strategic chibi girl. Very long straight crimson-red hair reaching past the knees, full fringe, a silver chess-knight-shaped hair clip on the right side. Large deep red eyes with a dark gradient, straight serious eyebrows, small closed mouth. Outfit: a crimson wool military-style coat with silver diamond studs on the cuffs and lapels, a black leather belt with a silver buckle and a small dangling silver charm; a black turtleneck underneath; a dark charcoal pinstripe skirt; burgundy tights; dark red leather ankle boots with silver buckles.
艾莎-intj.props: silver chess knight hair clip; crimson leather hardcover book with gold border

牧师-enfj.name: 牧师
牧师-enfj.description: A warm, outgoing chibi boy. Golden-blonde messy fluffy yarn hair with a swept fringe and a tall ahoge. Large amber-brown eyes with a golden gradient, bright open-mouth smile. Outfit: a cream long tunic with a black-and-white clerical collar, a golden-yellow hooded cape and matching long stole with embroidered sun motifs and small hanging gold crosses, a gold cross pendant on a braided gold cord, a braided gold rope belt; brown trousers with embroidered cuffs; cream-and-brown lace-up boots with gold cross buckles.
牧师-enfj.props: gold cross pendant; cream prayer book with gold cross on the cover; golden sun-embroidered stole

陆姚-entj.name: 陆姚
陆姚-entj.description: A stern, commanding chibi boy. Short black yarn hair with a side-swept fringe. Large dark charcoal-grey eyes with a subtle silver gradient, straight sharp eyebrows, small closed mouth, serious expression. Outfit: a black peaked officer cap with a glossy black visor and a silver diamond badge; a black double-breasted long coat with burgundy lining, silver buttons, silver shoulder tabs and burgundy piping; a burgundy tie over a black shirt; a black leather belt with a diagonal cross strap and silver buckle; black trousers; black lace-up boots with silver buckles.
陆姚-entj.props: black peaked officer cap with silver diamond badge; burgundy tie
陆姚-entj.turnaround_note: Include the peaked cap in all four views. Then add a FIFTH view at the far right: front view WITHOUT the cap, showing the full black hairstyle.

软软-infp.name: 软软
软软-infp.description: A shy, tender chibi girl. Soft coral-pink fluffy yarn hair with a straight fringe, two low twin tails tied with cream ribbon bows, and a single curled ahoge. Large rose-pink eyes with a red gradient and teary sparkle, upward-slanting worried eyebrows, tiny pouting mouth, heavy blush. Outfit: a cream chunky knit cardigan with a pink heart patch on the pocket and small pearl buttons; a dusty-pink pinafore dress with a white round collar and a white ruffle hem; cream ribbed knit tights; pink Mary Jane shoes with a small white flower on the strap.
软软-infp.props: cream plush bunny with long floppy ears and a pink bow; cream ribbon hair bows

prop_items.desc: A soft cream-coloured plush bunny doll about the size of the character's head: long floppy ears that hang down, a round chubby body, short stubby arms and legs, small stitched black bead eyes, a tiny pink embroidered nose, soft blush cheeks, and a dusty-pink ribbon bow tied around its neck. Felted-wool / fleece plush texture with visible fibres, slightly worn and well-loved.

Liiie-infj.name: Liiie
Liiie-infj.description: An elegant, doll-like chibi girl. Very long, voluminous wavy raspberry-magenta yarn hair reaching below the knees, with a small braid section on the right side, a deep-red felt rose hair ornament with a pearl chain and a tiny gold gem drop on the right side of her head, and a wine-red ribbon bow at the back. Large round rose-pink eyes with a magenta gradient and layered highlights, gentle slightly-worried thin eyebrows, soft blush, small closed mouth. Outfit: a wine-red / raspberry lolita-style dress with a white lace-trimmed high collar, a large wine-red bow at the neck with a pearl-and-ruby brooch, puffed long sleeves with white lace cuffs and pearl bracelets, a short wine-red capelet with cream fleece trim and embroidered rose motifs; a full tiered skirt with white lace ruffles and cream petticoat, decorated with small felt roses, pearls and wine-red bows; white knit tights with small bows; wine-red Mary-Jane heels with rose and bow details.
Liiie-infj.props: deep-red felt rose hair ornament with pearl chain; wine-red quilted handbag with a bow, ruby-and-pearl brooch and a pearl-bead handle

QC-entp.name: QC
QC-entp.description: A laid-back, cool chibi boy on holiday. Thick, tousled indigo-blue yarn hair swept back with loose strands falling over the forehead. Large sharp deep-blue eyes with white highlights, one eyebrow slightly raised, a small confident smirk, light tan skin. Wears black rectangular sunglasses pushed down to the tip of the nose so both eyes show above the frames. Outfit: an open short-sleeved navy-blue Hawaiian shirt with white palm-tree and wave prints and rolled cuffs, bare chest showing; matching navy board shorts with white drawstring and palm-tree print; a silver chain necklace with a small white seashell pendant; a white-and-blue bead bracelet with a tiny shell on the right wrist; navy strap sandals with white soles.
QC-entp.props: black rectangular sunglasses worn low on the nose; silver seashell necklace; blue-and-white bead bracelet; tall glass of iced orange drink with an orange slice, mint leaves and a black straw
QC-entp.turnaround_note: Keep the sunglasses pushed down low on the nose in every view so the eyes are visible above them. Do NOT include the drink glass; hands empty.
